Container.Name: buzz
Container.Overview: Unofficial Buzz desktop container with browser access, NVIDIA transcription, browser uploads, and persistent settings/models. Tested on Unraid 7.3.3 with a GTX 1080 8 GB. Open WebUI to use Buzz. Import mapped server files from /input (read-only), upload local files to /uploads through the sidebar file manager, and collect TXT/SRT/VTT exports from /output. Requires the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin and a compatible NVIDIA runtime. Local-network, single-user setup; browser microphone forwarding is not configured.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Open this port using the WebUI action.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated folder for settings, history and downloaded models.

Config.Name: Source files (read-only)
Config.Description: Choose the share containing your existing audio/video. Buzz cannot modify these originals.

Config.Name: Browser uploads
Config.Description: Upload laptop files here using the browser file manager, then open them in Buzz.

Config.Name: Transcripts
Config.Description: Automatic TXT, SRT and VTT exports. Download through the browser file manager or access the share.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: Use your GPU UUID from nvidia-smi -L; all is suitable for a server with one NVIDIA GPU.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: GPU computation and diagnostics; desktop rendering uses software.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user; match the owner of your writable folders.

Config.Name: File permission mask
Config.Description: New files are writable by the users group.

Config.Name: Reduce GPU memory
Config.Description: Enable INT8 inference; the container adapts it to Pascal GPUs.
